title: Org invite flow: modal → inviteLogic → bulk API
answers: How do organization invites work end to end?
Which endpoint does the invite modal call?
Where is invite creation validated on the backend?
What does inviteLogic do on success?
body:
- UI: frontend/src/scenes/settings/organization/InviteModal.tsx:InviteModal → InviteTeamMatesComponent → InviteRow per `invitesToSend` entry. Client validation is only `isEmail` in row onChange (sets `isValid`); MAX_INVITES_AT_ONCE=20; owner-level needs typed "send invites" (`isInviteConfirmed`).
- Logic: inviteLogic.ts loader `invitedTeamMembersInternal.inviteTeamMembers`: returns if !`canSubmit`, drops empty emails, copies shared `message`, awaits timeSensitiveAuthenticationLogic checkReauthentication, then `api.create` on `api/organizations/<id>/invites/bulk/`.
- Modal opens via URL: `bindModalToUrl` urlKey 'invite-members'.
- Backend: posthog/api/organization_invite.py:OrganizationInviteViewSet.bulk (non-list body rejected, >20 rows → code max_length, `OrganizationInviteSerializer(many=True)`, save, `report_bulk_invited`).
- Serializer: validate_target_email (EmailNormalizer, reject_plus_addressed_email, validate_invite_target_email_domain → code `verified_domain_required`), validate_level (PermissionDenied if above inviter), validate_private_project_access; `create` rejects existing members, combine/delete existing invites via OrganizationInviteManager, sends email if `is_email_available`.
- Success listener `inviteTeamMembersSuccess`: toast, reset rows to EMPTY_INVITE, reload org+invites; closes modal only if preflight email_service_available (else stays open for copying links).
- `delegate` action is a separate onboarding flow, not used by the modal.
says: Where does the invite modal send the form when I click send?
The invite modal validates emails before posting to the backend system.
After submitting invites, what validation does the server do next?
Sending team invites goes through modal, logic, then to the backend.
Client-side invite validation happens only on email address format.
